name: Z-Power Ring
description: A strange ring that enables Z-Move usage.

gifts.note: Postgame: after the Hall of Fame. The woman in the Verdanturf Poké Mart gives you the Z-Power Ring once you are Champion. With it, Necrozma fused with Solgaleo or Lunala can Ultra Burst while holding an Ultranecrozium Z, which the clerk sells after the Hall of Fame.
